qualification: local-fixture only; hosted Neon/region/network RTT unmeasured (#220)

target.statistic: nearest-rank p95 of per-read Q1+Q2 (not sum of p95s)

cacheState: warm/unflushed OS, file and database caches; connected restricted LOGIN; no cold/hosted claim
method: Baseline-only first, then six ABBA blocks x25 requests per position per shape; all samples retained. Baseline has three client queries; only its two rights/status queries are timed for comparison. Candidate folds pin retrieval into Q1.

probes.name: two query work and hidden-work negative control
real reader LOGIN refusals and zero GET on initial refusal
rights revoked at each GET and during trusted calculation withholds all output
exact source/dataset invalidation, immutable first receipt and shared-retained re-arm
paused reader has no coordination locks and concurrent deletion commits
orphan sweep removes bytes while removal pending; retirement permits idempotent completion

detail.fixtureClock: owner adjusts scratch observation age; no real 24h wait

probes.name: unknown slots refuse and an unrelated real LOGIN has no artifact authority
publication before deletion and deletion before publication serialize correctly
lost COMMIT reply on a live publication retries to one original run

detail.fault: server COMMIT succeeds; client drops result/connection and retries on another connection

probes.name: configured grace and unlink-before-ack crash resume are idempotent
bounded cleanup pages progress past shared-retained and observed addresses
deletion during each file GET and calculation withholds delivery
mandatory cleanup fixed client work budgets

limitations: Disposable mechanism SQL and copied orchestration are not implementation or CI qualification.
Automatic SELECT AccessShareLock is expected; no explicit reader coordination lock or transaction spans I/O/calculation.
No completed-removal recovery lane or paused/late-PUT handoff tests; #229 owns them.
Direct-SQL concurrency graph fixtures are synthetic and do not claim report-envelope provenance.
A pending removal may outlast byte removal until orphan retirement (24h default); byte removal and completion clocks are separate.
